basic_identification.full_title: Brushes for Electrical Machines — Specification (विद्युत मशीनों के ब्रश — विशिष्टि)
basic_identification.sector_category: Electrotechnical / Rotating Machinery (approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council and finalized by the Rotating Machinery Sectional Committee, ET 15 / ETD 15, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

scope.summary: This Indian Standard prescribes the quality requirements, physical-mechanical design configurations, preferred dimensional combinations, and testing methods for carbon brushes (such as carbon, carbon-graphite, electrographitic, graphite, and metal-graphite blocks) fitted with flexible copper conductors (shunts/pigtails) used in rotating electrical machines.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Material Specification (Electrotechnical Department / Rotating Machinery)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Product Certification. Every manufacturer of carbon brushes is highly encouraged to obtain a valid BIS license to stamp or emboss the physical ISI 'Standard Mark' on the product packaging, indicating compliance with IS 13466.

requirements.detail: Observed or calculated final test values, pigtail dimensions, or joint drop voltages must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.

Brush dimensions must always be stated in millimeters in the sequence t * a * r, representing tangential thickness (t), axial width (a), and radial length (r). Square section brushes are not recommended.

Defines parameter g (clearance from the top of the brush block or bevel to the entry point of embedded flexibles). For 4 flexibles, Table 6 provides standardized maximum g limits between 13 and 21 mm.
Flexible copper shunts must be securely crimped or crimped and soldered to terminal ends (e.g. open spade, closed spade, flag, or double shoe) as per the purchaser's specifications.
Assembled brushes must be examined under a magnifying glass of minimum 10X magnification factor for structural cracks, edge chipping, surface smoothness, and loose connections.
Evaluates joint resistance between the carbon block and the flexible shunt using a millivolt drop tester under specified currents.

Conducted only for brushes with tamped or molded connections. The shunt wire must withstand pull tests using test rigs in Annex E, with pull-out strengths exceeding the specified thresholds in Table 3.

keywords: Dimensional sequence t x a x r

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 13466 : 1992 (Reaffirmed 2003) is the primary national Indian Standard specification prescribing design, dimensional, material, and testing requirements for carbon brushes used in electrical rotating machines. Maintained under the Rotating Machinery Sectional Committee (ET 15), the standard supersedes older parts of the IS 3003 series and aligns with international standards IEC 60136 and IEC 60773. It mandates a strict t x a x r dimensional convention (tangential, axial, radial dimensions), defines preferred size combinations, and prohibits square-section brushes to prevent mechanical instability. The code regulates pigtail flex shunts, standardizes g-value clearances, and enforces a rigorous quality control scheme—including 10X magnifying glass checks, millivolt drop tests, and pigtail pull-out strength tests—supported by standard double-sampling acceptance tables under Annex C to guarantee reliable motor operation across national grids.
